info.text:
Roku sells its streaming sticks and TVs at a loss. On purpose.
In 2025, Roku's Devices segment had $592.4M in revenue and an $82.0M gross loss (FY2025 10-K).
Its Platform segment, ads and subscriptions, made $4.14B, 87.5% of revenue, with about a 52% gross margin.
Platform revenue grew from $2.71B in 2022 to $4.14B in 2025. Fox agreed in June 2026 to buy Roku in a deal valued at about $22B, pending regulatory approval.
Sources: Roku FY2025 and FY2022 10-Ks, Variety.
News and education, not financial advice.
